newsitem.title: INDIA: ONGC, OIL new finds to get global price.
newsitem.headline: ONGC, OIL new finds to get global price.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday that under a new exploration licensing policy, firms including state-controlled ONGC Corp and Oil India Ltd (OIL) will be paid the international price of oil for new discoveries.
Chidambaram said the petroleum minister would soon announce a new exploration licensing policy, under which royalty payments would be fixed on an ad valorem basis.
Royalty payments for deep water exploration would be charged at half the rate for offshore areas for the first seven years after commencement of commercial production, he said.
Refineries would be allowed to import capital goods at a concessional duty, and domestic capital goods suppliers would get deemed export status, Chidambaram said.
